thread:
lena: quick sync notes from arch huddle — we need to settle on burst vs reservoir semantics for tenant admission. goal: predictable billing + graceful fairness.
omar: tl;dr: billing should track tokens consumed; admission should be allowed to soft-shed without debiting billing tokens on the shed path.
harry: agree. idea: maintain two counters per tenant: committed_quota (long lived, decremented on admit) and transient_reservoir (short lived, used only for immediate admit decisions). reservoir refills on a separate cadence.
sre-bot: FYI: simulated shared-nat shows hard denies burst false-positive rate 22% vs soft-shed 3%. Recommend default soft-shed with emergency hard block flag.
zoe: how large should reservoirs be? suggestion: adaptive reservoir size proportional to recent p95 qps per tenant, with floor/ceiling. prevents tiny tenants from being starved by noisy bursts.
lena: good. also need eviction rules for fairness_shards state when we shard per-api-key. We can LRU shards by recent hits plus a decay score. If shard evicted, it maps to 'default' fairness shard to avoid surprises.
harry: interface: Frontdoor sends {canonical_tenant, route, est_tokens, optional_fingerprint} as request metadata. Admission returns {admit: true/false, mode: soft|hard, charge: yes|no, reason_code}. Keep it minimal.
omar: telemetry: emit reservoir_size, reservoir_fill_rate, reservoir_used, committed_balance, shed_reason. This will let us tune adaptive rules.
zoe: ops playbook: emergency hard block allowed iff incident_id && manual_approve && dont_charge_on_override flag set. Otherwise use probabilistic ramping based on abuse_score.
lena: action items: 1) Harry to prototype reservoir refill heuristic and publish sim results (owner: harry, due Tue). 2) Omar to update admission API contract (owner: omar, due Thu). 3) Zoe to draft ops playbook hard-block checklist (owner: zoe, due two weeks).
harry: i'll run sims against last 7 days of ingress traces and post numbers.
lena: perfect. merging into admission-refactor if no objections in 36h.
